miso_sck_low.desc: MISO is sampled while SCK is low (into a flop at the rising SCK edge), so it reads noise.

mosi_on_rise.desc: MOSI presents the next bit while SCK is high, so it changes on the rising SCK edge.

fail.rvfi: MOSI changed on a rising SCK edge
fail.pins: MOSI changed on a rising SCK edge

cs_sck_high.desc: CS_n rises on the same edge SCK falls (SCK was high), after the last bit.

fail.rvfi: CS_n changed while SCK was high
fail.pins: CS_n changed while SCK was high

write_midbyte.desc: A WRITE transaction stops 4 bits early, in the middle of its last data byte.

rvfi_rd_wrong.desc: RVFI reports a wrong rd value for SUB and SRA (the register file itself is right).

rvfi_hidden.desc: SLTU/SLTIU are right only in the RISCV_FORMAL build: the plain build computes <=.

zero_init.desc: pc has no reset: the core relies on it powering up as 0.

latency.desc: Every load and store waits 1,000 extra cycles before retiring (latency cap 1,024).

no_halt.desc: EBREAK retires as a trap but the core keeps running.

trap_writes_rd.desc: A JAL whose target has bit 1 set traps but still writes rd.

uo_late.desc: uo_out takes the IO store's value two cycles after the store retires.

fail.rvfi: one cycle after the IO store retired

fetch_extra_byte.desc: The fetch READ clocks 8 more bits: a fifth byte that isn't the instruction's.

cs_open_at_retire.desc: After a data access CS_n stays low until the retirement edge (open during rvfi_valid).

legal_trap_fields.desc: Legal: arbitrary rd_wdata and pc_wdata on trapping retirements, arbitrary rs1/rs2 fields on traps that read no register (contract section 6, e321614: a trapping branch or JALR reports truthful rs fields).

stall_gap.desc: Every retirement is held back until exactly `STALL_GAP cycles after the previous one (or after reset release): 1,025 by default, one more than the latency cap. Built with +define+STALL_GAP=1024 it is legal; +define+STALL_SKIP_FIRST exempts the first instruction.

ui_at_retire.desc: IO loads return ui_in sampled in the cycle after the previous retirement (before their own fetch completed) instead of after the fetch.

uo_glitch.desc: An IO store shows its value on uo_out in EXEC, restores the old value for the retirement cycle, then writes it again (a glitch and return before retirement).

load_own_fetch.desc: An LW whose address is its own pc returns the fetched instruction word without an SPI READ of its own (the value is right; contract section 6 requires the READ).

legal_mosi_echo.desc: Legal: no header gate on the shift-in, so after a 56-bit transaction's last bit (CS_n still low) MOSI carries MISO's header-phase noise; the contract constrains MOSI only at rising SCK edges.

store_twice.desc: Every RAM store sends its WRITE transaction twice (each store byte written twice).

store_extra_byte.desc: SB sends 2 data bytes: its own and the next one (rs2[15:8]), a byte outside the store.

load_skip_byte.desc: LW reads only its first 3 bytes over SPI and takes the 4th from the shift register.

legal_split_store.desc: Legal: SW is split into two 2-byte WRITEs (bytes 0-1 at addr, then bytes 2-3 at addr + 2); contract v2 section 6 allows a store to be split, each byte once.

region_wrap.desc: hyp/002-rf-in-ram with register slots at 0xFFC2 + 4r: x15's 4-byte transactions run 0xFFFE..0x0001, out of the core region.

fail.rvfi: wraps out of the core region
fail.pins: wraps out of the core region

region_straddle.desc: hyp/002-rf-in-ram with its scratch slot (pc spill/restore around RAM stores) at 0xFF7E instead of 0xFFC0: those 4-byte transactions straddle 0xFF7F/0xFF80.

fail.rvfi: runs from program RAM into the core region
fail.pins: runs from program RAM into the core region

legal_h002_rf.desc: Legal: hyp/002-rf-in-ram (fc07cc3) as is: x1..x15 in the region at 0xFFC0 + 4r, pc on the die, pc spill/restore through the scratch slot around RAM stores.

legal_h002_pcram.desc: Legal: hyp/002-rf-in-ram-pcram (b9a5211) as is: the pc in the region too (read before the fetch), scratch at 0xFF80, SW split into two 2-byte WRITEs.

region_zero_init.desc: hyp/002-rf-in-ram-pcram without its boot write: the first slot after reset keeps CS_n high, so the pc comes from whatever the region held at reset. It works only if the region starts zero (contract section 3: its contents at reset are arbitrary; the cosim fills it with random bytes).

hang_reserved.desc: Custom-0 (opcode 0001011, reserved) stays in EXEC forever instead of trapping; only the liveness fuzz sees it.

legal_null_read.desc: Legal: a null READ (header only, at the IO address) before every IO load; contract section 6 (78472fe) allows any number anywhere.

trap_rs_garbage.desc: Arbitrary rs1/rs2 fields on every trapping retirement, a trapping branch or JALR included (contract section 6, e321614, checks those).

hang_funct3.desc: LOAD with the reserved funct3 011 and registers x0..x15 stays in EXEC forever instead of trapping; only the liveness fuzz sees it.

null_read_short.desc: legal_null_read with a 23-bit header: CS_n rises before the 24-bit command and address are complete (rule 4).

fail.rvfi: before its command and address were complete
fail.pins: before its command and address were complete
